]> 24/08/2026 7:19 More sun for Monday!.

Happy Monday from Perisher, where it's currently 3 degrees with clear skies. Expect a mix of sun and cloud as the day progresses, with a top of 9 degrees and west to north-westerly winds 15-25km/h.

34 lifts are scheduled to spin today, with 39 runs groomed across the resort, and conditions underfoot will be soft.

If you're heading to Blue Cow today, please note that Interceptor Quad Chair is closed and there's no ski access from Perisher to Blue Cow: you'll need to take the Skitube instead. You can still ski back from Blue Cow to Perisher via the Perisher Home Trail or Copperhead Road!

The FIS Australia and New Zealand Cup kicks off today, with the first day of competition held on Toppa's Dream. Best of luck to all competitors!

Don't forget, there are great savings to be had at Slopestyle and Perisher Sports, with up to 50% off select products while stocks last, so get in quick!

Enjoy the Monday laps, and make the most of the current conditions before some wild weather moves in tomorrow.
